summary:
Implemented `renovate.json`, the trusted-main weekly dependency-submission workflow, package-access preflight, `docs/dependency-automation.md`, and the README link. The workflow uses basic caching and keeps package credentials separate from `${{ github.token }}`. No dependencies or service logic changed.

Passed: Node 24/npm prerequisite, strict Renovate config validation, actionlint, link checks, and diff checks. Extraction found 57 occurrences across eight files covering Gradle, the wrapper, Dockerfile images, and Actions; all three `org.budgetanalyzer` coordinates were detected. Public lookups returned 47 candidate branches. Authenticated Actions and private-Maven lookups remain pending because this runner has no GitHub/package token.

The official snapshot generator ran, but the snapshot is incomplete: it contains only 87 build/tool coordinates and omits the application runtime/test tree because `serviceCommon` 0.0.16 cannot be remotely resolved without credentials. Gradle confirmed those configurations as failed. Actions run 34027551741 succeeded on the exact 0.0.16 bump commit, establishing that repository secrets exist, but completing this phase requires either exposing the scoped package-read credentials to this runner for a fresh snapshot or committing the prepared workflow and running it successfully on `main`, then confirming GitHub accepted the submission.
